# Workflows

- `pr-gate.yml`: strict source/tests types, canonical contract checks,
  conservative affected-test selection, and real GUI browser smoke.
- `pages.yml`: bounded isolated municipal acquisition, fresh feeds, complete
  same-edition public-tree validation, and unchanged Pages upload/deploy.
- `weekly.yml`: full current-cycle monitor evidence, with exact artifact handoff
  from optional manual scraping to downstream verification/analysis.

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Offline configuration checks, hosted runs, live source
acceptance, and public deployment are separate evidence planes.
